name: 82520 · Lander, WY
findings: ZIP 82520 (Lander) has 83 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 82520 (Lander) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 82520 (Lander) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
